queries:
WITH ct AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
s AS (
  SELECT total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM ct) AS share
  FROM ct
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s
)
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(total) FROM ct) AS avg_total_spent,
  (SELECT avg_share FROM a) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_share_diff
FROM s
WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a);
SELECT AVG(c.total * 1.0 / g.grand) AS avg_share
FROM (
  SELECT cu.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total
  FROM Customer cu
  LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = cu.CustomerId
  GROUP BY cu.CustomerId
) c
CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(Total) AS grand FROM Invoice) g;
SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) >= (SELECT AVG(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId));
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.FirstName, c.LastName;
